cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders
LIMIT 100

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.region
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.region, c.city, c.status FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL
LIMIT 100
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM customers WHERE status = 'active'
LIMIT 100

SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_order_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.region
LIMIT 100

SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category
LIMIT 100

SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total_order_amount FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id
LIMIT 100

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-08-01' AND created_at < '2026-09-01'
LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name, c.region, c.city, c.status FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
LIMIT 100
